An evidence build's provenance receipt

Source: R/evidence_receipt.R
knw_evidence_receipt_write.Rd

Writes evidence_receipt.json into an evidence directory, beside the tables scripts/0310 builds there, in crate's shared receipt shape (crate::crt_receipt_write(), #160): how the build was made (knowledge's commit, the method register and the walk's SQL, the build's settings, link's build, wet's flow load, the FDIS extract and its load, and the tracked tables it reads) and what came out (every table, fingerprinted, the placed visits and access_check's km). The declaration (knw_receipt_keys()("evidence")) holds every table exact but access_check's km, which a database summing in another order moves in the last place, so a rebuild compared with this receipt (crate::crt_receipt_compare()) answers identical, equivalent, or different. A grade graded on the build names it by this receipt's recipe_id (knw_grade_receipt_write()), so an equivalent rebuild of the evidence is the same input to every grade. The receipt carries no host, because the evidence it describes is public.

Usage

knw_evidence_receipt_write(
  evidence_dir,
  settings,
  inputs,
  knowledge,
  context = list()
)

Arguments

evidence_dir

character(1) the evidence directory, holding the seven tables the declaration fingerprints.

settings

a named list of the build's settings the declaration lists: species, q_grid, sources, snap_limit_m, snap_limit_code_m, parent.

inputs

a named list of the inputs the declaration lists, each in crate's form (list(version_id = ), list(sha256 = ), list(none = )).

knowledge

list(commit, dirty): knowledge's full commit and whether its tracked package files or scripts differed from it, read at the build's start (.knw_git_state()).

context

a named list carried into the receipt's context (the run's identifiers, link's version and commit); never part of its identity.

Value

The receipt as read back from the file just written (crate::crt_receipt_read()), invisibly.

Details

The tables are read back from their CSVs as text, as a reader gets them, with access_check's km read as a number.

Examples

ev <- tempfile(); dir.create(ev)
tbl <- c("visits_link", "visits_species", "walks", "bcfishobs_fdis_match", "workbook_sites", "workbook_species")
for (f in tbl) utils::write.csv(data.frame(site_visit = c("a", "b")), file.path(ev, paste0(f, ".csv")),
                                row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(data.frame(species_code = "BT", km = 787407.1195799585), file.path(ev, "access_check.csv"),
                 row.names = FALSE)
inputs <- lapply(stats::setNames(nm = knw_receipt_keys("evidence")$inputs), function(i) list(version_id = "x"))
settings <- list(species = c("BT", "CH"), q_grid = c(1, 3), sources = "pick", snap_limit_m = 100,
                 snap_limit_code_m = 150, parent = "none")
r <- knw_evidence_receipt_write(ev, settings, inputs, knowledge = list(commit = strrep("a", 40), dirty = FALSE))
r$result$summary$visits
#> [1] 2
r$recipe$recipe_id
#> [1] "1286b1bf87392dbf5fffb19822f65c0e6f445b8dc1e2e6b2c38571d2cb56513d"
